item.title: Blaine N. Schoening, 66, identified as victim in Bartlett fuel tank explosion
item.description: Fremont County Sheriff’s Office has identified Blaine N. Schoening, 66, of Council Bluffs, as the victim killed in a March 24, 2026, explosion at J-Dogg Salvage Yard in Bartlett, Iowa. One fatality reported; no other injuries.

item.title: Multiple arrests after large bar fight in downtown Cedar Rapids; one officer injured
item.description: Cedar Rapids police responded to a large bar fight in the 400 block of 2nd Ave SE early Sunday morning. Multiple people were arrested on charges including public intoxication, disorderly conduct, and interference with official acts. One officer sustained minor injuries.

item.title: Driver found dead in U-Haul off I-29 near Percival, Iowa, early Monday
item.description: Authorities say a 60-year-old man was found dead in a U-Haul off northbound I-29 at the Percival exit in Fremont County early Monday. Iowa State Patrol is investigating.

item.title: St. Louis County AMBER Alert: 5-year-old still missing after car theft in Affton
item.description: Authorities issued an AMBER Alert after 5-year-old Alesia Dawson was taken in a stolen vehicle in Affton. The car was recovered, but she remains missing.

item.title: Oelwein domestic assault leads to two arrests in Fayette County
item.description: Fayette County Sheriff's Office arrested Madison Royall, 22, of Keizer, OR, and Thaddeus Walker, 22, of Maynard, IA, following a domestic assault investigation in Oelwein on March 24, 2026. Both are held in Fayette County Jail.

item.title: Iowa investors ask judge to void personal guaranties, put US 212 Beef plant under court control
item.description: Renville County judge set to hear post-trial motions over US 212 Beef, including personal guaranty liability and a receivership bid for the Buffalo Lake plant.
